review_notes:
I read the whole file and compared it with Mathlib/GroupTheory/DoubleCoset.lean. I also grepped Mathlib for other Hecke ring, coset or pair definitions. The only match was this file, so nothing else in Mathlib competes with it.

Closest candidate: `HeckeCoset Δ H₁ H₂` is a quotient of the subtype `↥Δ`. It is built by pulling back `DoubleCoset.setoid` along `Subtype.val`. `DoubleCoset.Quotient` quotients all of `G`, so the two are different types: the first is a quotient of `↥Δ` and the second a quotient of `G`. The file reuses the existing setoid rather than redefining it, and the docstring explains why the setoid is not a global instance. I found no duplicated API.

`HeckeCosetModule` is a def wrapping `HeckeCoset Δ H₁ H₂ →₀ Z`, with instances and an `of` equivalence. This is an intentional type synonym that later files can give a convolution structure. It does not compete with `Finsupp`.

`IsHeckeTriple` reuses `Commensurable` and `commensurator`. I found no existing Mathlib class for this compatibility condition.

Remaining uncertainty: I did not check the later files that build on this one. I judged that consolidation has no clear practical case, so I abstained.
